I've been with Chacewater 4 years now. I had developed an incredible fear of going to the doctors thanks to my previous doctor. I still haven't completely shaken the fear but since going to the Chacewater practice and having been listened to, genuinely cared for and treated like a human being with feelings: my fear has greatly lessened. I've also been diagnosed with physical health issues that my previous doctor had dismissed the symptoms of and put down to anxiety (whilst rolling her eyes at me). I'm on lifelong medication and now receiving proper care. The hospital at Truro have also been simply brilliant.

far as I am concerned this Health Centre sets a standard of service that many others would do well to emulate.
Nothing is too much trouble, the doctors and staff are invariably courteous and friendly and I know of no other health centre where patients can actually choose the day of their appointment..
There are an increasing number of health centres who require patients to phone at 8.00a.m and if there are no available appointments on that day then you try again tomorrow at 8.00a.m. The Chacewater staff bend over backwards to try to accommodate patients at the patient's convenience.
